title: Quotes
sub: Create, send and track service quotes.
aiDo: Let an AI agent handle it now
aiDoing: AI agent is working on quote {code}

form.title: New quote
form.linesHint: Product · Qty · Unit price · Discount · Tax · Amount
form.required: Pick a customer and add at least one priced line
form.needApproval: Over threshold ({reasons}) — submit for approval before sending.

detail.pdfFail: Could not load the quote PDF, please try again.

sendErr.no_conversation_zalo_personal: This customer has not messaged you on Zalo yet — personal Zalo cannot start a chat; send by email or wait for the customer.
sendErr.no_email: This customer has no email — add one to the profile and send again.
sendErr.connector: No Email channel connected — connect one in Settings › Channels.
sendErr.noImage: This channel cannot send images — pick PDF.

hint.sent: Customer received the quote — send an offer / answer concerns to close.
hint.viewed: Customer opened the quote — send an offer / answer concerns to close.
hint.approved: Approved internally — push the customer to confirm within 48h.
hint.accepted: Won — move on to a contract / order.
hint.other: Finish the line items and send.

detail.needApproval: Over threshold ({reasons}) — needs approval before sending.
detail.pending: Waiting for approval — an approver will handle it in Approvals.
detail.oldHint: Returning customer — loyalty points are used at payment (not deducted on the quote).

act.ask: Customer asked for a better offer

detail.validity: The quote expires {n} days after sending.
detail.suggestOld: Loyal returning customer — keep the price and add one free session to close fast; avoid deep discounts.
detail.suggestNew: New customer — a "saver bundle" + first-time offer lifts close chance by ~12%.
detail.followText: No reply for over 2 days → send a Zalo reminder with -10% if they close within 48h.
detail.convertSoon: The {kind} is created on its own screen — open {route}

aiPanel.title: AI Assistant · Quotes
aiPanel.intro: I reviewed the quote pipeline: 1 has had no reply for over 3 days. I can suggest prices, draft content or send follow-ups. What do you need?

runs.suggD: Suggest packages / prices from customer history
runs.draftD: Paste a note / chat — AI drafts from the catalog
runs.analyzeD: Why quotes are lost & how to improve

aiPanel.ph: Ask the AI Assistant about quotes…

prompts.sugg: Suggest suitable packages / combos and pricing for the customer of the open quote (or selected quotes) based on purchase history.
prompts.followup: List sent quotes with no customer response for more than 3 days and suggest how to follow up.
prompts.analyze: Analyse the quote close rate: accepted / rejected / expired counts and the main reasons for losses.

draft.title: AI quote draft from text
draft.sub: Figures come from the catalog; off-catalog lines or discounts > 5% require approval. AI only drafts.
draft.contentPh: E.g. Ms Lan takes HIFU lift 8 sessions + facial combo, 5% off
draft.required: Pick a customer and enter content

public.title: Quote {code} · version {n}
public.expired: This quote has expired — please contact us to extend it.
public.contact: To accept or ask for changes, reply in the conversation where you received this link.
public.invalidTitle: This quote link is no longer valid
public.invalidSub: Please contact the sender for a new quote.

channelNote.zalo_personal: Only after the customer has messaged the shop on Zalo.
channelNote.email: Opens a new email thread if there is none yet.
channelNote.webchat: Posts to the website chat with a view / download link (expires with the quote).

formatNote.pdf: The approved PDF, frozen at send time.
formatNote.image: One PNG per page, rendered from the same approved PDF — all pages, same amounts.
